description:
Beast of Reincarnation Review - Polished but Generic
In this Fextralife video, I'm going to be talking about my hands-on impressions with the latest action RPG developed by Game Freak, Beast of Reincarnation. The developer is mainly known for their Pokemon games, and this game is their foray into a different genre. And whether Game Freak succeeds in delivering a solid action RPG experience or not is what we're going to be discussing in the video.
